title: BIAS, DIVERSITY, AND CHALLENGES TO FAIRNESS IN CLASSIFICATION AND AUTOMATED TEXT ANALYSIS. From libraries to AI and back
reasoning: The paper includes a significant analysis of how religion is represented and classified in systems like the Dewey Decimal Classification (DDC), specifically examining the ethical implications of grouping non-Christian faiths into 'Other Religions' vs. detailed sub-categories for Christianity. It treats this as a core example of representational harm and a challenge to fairness and ethics in information science.
